newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey's Alarko trust to sell building.
newsitem.headline: Turkey's Alarko trust to sell building.

text.p: Turkish Alarko Holding said its newly established real estate investment trust would sell a semi-finished building from its portolio for $18.5 million plus value added tax to private Osmanli Bank.

In a statement sent to the Istanbul Stock Exchange, Alarko whose main activity is contracting and real estate development, said an agreement was reached to sell the semi-finished business centre in Istanbul's newly developing business district Maslak.
The Holding had set up Alarko real estate investment trust with a 400 billion lira capital in July. Its 99 percent stake is controlled by the Holding and other Alarko group firms.
Alarko Holding shares ended at 13,500 lira on Tuesday morning, up from 13,000 at Monday's close.
